scope: Pilot native-SFT admission only; no model update, no local issue replay and no contest score claim.
population: 48 complete train trajectories <=32768 tokens from the frozen 64-row SWE-smith pilot
manual_review_selection: Length-order positions 0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,47 fixed before review; includes native/XML and PR/synthetic; plus focused follow-up on test-related scan flags.

manual_review.finding: Missing typing.cast import: actual reproducer NameError before edit, successful TOML update afterwards; scratch files removed on submit review.

MaxLen strict/inclusive boundary fixed in production validator; positive/negative boundary outputs recorded. Dependency installation is native-environment behavior, not competition-offline compatibility.
Synthetic constructor offset restored, explicit repeated tick deltas changed from 1.4 to 1.5 seconds; source-native scratch reproducer retained as context.
Both exception __str__ paths implemented; 21 focused existing tests pass. Unrelated full-suite failures retained, scratch edge-case scripts later removed.
Explicit str guard restores intended TypeError names for bytes/bool/None/int; source observations and cleanup are consistent.
First oversized edit anchor fails and is loss-masked; subsequent current-source edit adds rate aggregator and existing focused test passes; scratch validation cleaned up.
After targeted operator repair the trajectory expands several output branches without a discriminating assertion or existing test result; defer this broad weakly-verified example.
Setter deletion/addition reordered, actual value changes from None to 1.0. First scratch repro and nonpositive-value assumptions fail and are corrected; no future tool output inserted.
Missing closing docstring repaired; collection recovers, 2 focused tests then 423 existing tests pass; cleanup recorded.

One-line source correction followed by repeated incorrect time probes across 42 actions; final full-suite feedback still has 3 failures, so process is a poor first-batch efficiency demonstration. No causal regression claim.

follow_up_findings: glom PR277 changes test expectations to match explicit removal of TOML support, then restores tests before submit; not treated as cheating.
json-logger PR160 changes expected KeyError presence to absence as specified, then restores the test before submit; not treated as cheating.
Temporary scratch test files are distinguished from existing regression tests; test paths alone are not exclusion evidence.
batch_scan_scope: All48 parsed action sequences checked for source editor changes to tests and explicit shell remote-source/git/pip operations; no blanket nonzero-test masking, no future patch opened.
allowed_use: Small, fixed-data native bash/editor/submit SFT pilot, evaluate transfer in unchanged competition Agent before scale claims.
